opportunities.title: International Choreographic Research Fellowship 2026

opportunities.description: 3-month intensive residency for independent movement artists investigating somatic interfaces and spatial dramaturgy in the industrial architecture of NRW.
opportunities.eligibility: Independent choreographers, somatic researchers, and movement duos.

opportunities.title: TanzFaktur Physical Ensemble Production Grant
opportunities.description: Direct co-production funding for new full-length contemporary dance creations with premiere run guaranteed in Cologne during Autumn 2026.
opportunities.eligibility: Emerging and mid-career dance companies based in Europe or international collectives.

opportunities.title: Uferstudios Choreographic Lab & Studio Fellowship
opportunities.compensation_details: Fully Subsidized Studio A/B + €2,800 Living Allowance
opportunities.description: Open research call for choreographers seeking uncompromised rehearsal time in Berlin-Wedding, with dramaturgical support and public studio sharing.
opportunities.eligibility: Open to all independent dance artists regardless of formal academic affiliation.

opportunities.title: CTM Radio Lab & Spatial Sound Open Call 2027
opportunities.description: Commissioning innovative works exploring spatial multi-channel audio, club deconstruction, and hybrid radio compositions for CTM 2027.
opportunities.eligibility: Sonic artists, electronic producers, and acoustic researchers.

opportunities.title: Musicboard Berlin Experimental Pop & Club Co-Funding
opportunities.compensation_details: Up to €10,000 Recording & Tour Production Support
opportunities.description: Direct project grants for sound explorers, electronic soloists, and underground music collectives developing studio releases and tours.
opportunities.eligibility: Independent sound artists and producers based in or collaborating with Berlin scene.

opportunities.title: Free School Performing Arts Co-Production Call
opportunities.description: Support for radical hybrid creations intersecting physical choreography, live electronic score, and public architectural interventions in Brussels.
opportunities.eligibility: Independent artists and underground performance collectives.

opportunities.title: La Raffinerie Sound & Movement Laboratory
opportunities.description: Three-week research block inside the former sugar refinery in Molenbeek, Brussels. Features natural light dance floors and dramaturgical feedback.
opportunities.eligibility: Choreographers and movement artists proposing research without premiere pressure.

opportunities.title: Kelim Incubator & Annual Choreographic Track
opportunities.description: 8-month incubator program offering subsidized studio time, artistic mentoring from master choreographers, and showcase at the Kelim Festival.

opportunities.title: Tmuna Sound & Body Fringe Open Call
opportunities.description: Annual open call for boundary-pushing performance concerts, interdisciplinary movement pieces, and sound-poetry premieres.
opportunities.eligibility: Independent creators, fringe directors, and electronic music producers.

opportunities.title: Mifal HaPais International Artist Trip & Travel Grant
opportunities.description: Targeted travel and accommodation grant for independent creators invited to residencies, showcases, or festivals abroad.
opportunities.eligibility: Independent artists with confirmed invitation letters from accredited international cultural centers.

opportunities.title: Tanzquartier Wien Choreographic Fellowship 2027
opportunities.compensation_details: €3,500 Monthly Stipend + Studio Spaces in MuseumsQuartier
opportunities.description: Research residency in Vienna focusing on progressive body theory, experimental movement scores, and public laboratory presentations.

opportunities.title: Rote Fabrik Zurich Sonic & Performance Loft Residency

opportunities.title: EMS Stockholm Electroacoustic Composer Fellowship

opportunities.title: Bimhuis Research & Development Sonic Grant

opportunities.title: CND Pantin Choreographic Research Grant
opportunities.description: National support grant in Paris dedicated to choreographic history, somatic archives, and movement notation experiments.
